_comment: catalog/fly-idle-signals.json — which idle signal bin/fly-idle-reaper.sh asks for each Fly app (BH-6061, BH-6877).
An exact `apps` key wins over any prefix; among prefixes the longest match wins, and it must match from the start.
Sources: pool (state/fly-pool tracking files + claimed queue rows), builder (active dispatcher records + claimed queue rows),
lane-run (GET /api/lane-fleet/machines claims), testhost (bin/testhost-tick.sh idle), metrics (Fly Prometheus CPU and
net rates), exempt (never stopped; `reason` is required). An app with no match gets `metrics`. A new source needs code
in the reaper, so this file is in git, not a settings row.

bh-ci-runners-example-org.reason: BH-1210 warm minimum: the runner fleet keeps started machines on purpose (docs/CI-RUNNERS.md)

project-12-.reason: customer bots stay up; a retired or lab project-12 app gets an exact metrics entry
